expectations.evidence: Section 8 sets the measurement rung explicitly: UTM + last-non-direct as the floor, then 'Add self-reported attribution immediately ("How did you hear about this campaign?" on the action page) — required the moment a creation channel enters the mix'. expectations.text: The recommended awareness plan carries a measurement design suited to weak click-level reads (self-reported, incrementality-style, or equivalent).
expectations.evidence: The KPI section leads with click/conversion-level metrics: 'Cost per petition signature / MEP contact generated (primary metric)' and 'Video completion rate.' There is no incrementality design — no geo holdout, no matched-market control, no brand-lift or survey instrument, no self-reported attribution ('how did you hear about us') on the petition/MEP-contact form, no pre/post baseline.
